title: Concept: X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies value is not a recognised token
description: An unrecognised X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies token is ignored, so the declared restriction on cross-domain policy files is not applied as written.
risk: A legacy client may load a cross-domain policy the deployment meant to forbid, or refuse one it meant to allow; LOW because the affected clients are legacy and the default is usually restrictive.
